title: 第1440章 流着哈喇子等待放饭第1439章 他的目标是每天三万袋
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 叶苜苜特意寻找战承胤，看他现在在哪儿。
没在皇宫前的广场，没在城墙上，也不在巡逻军指挥中心。
最后在守城军武器库房里找到。
库房是蔺校尉和孙将军带他来的，武器库外面上万战家军层层把守。
陪同战承胤一起去的，有肖逸，还有一位叫做晨辉的指挥官。
肖逸打开一箱武器，里面放着全部都是枪。
这枪还有些许眼熟。
之前齐国围堵楚国，向战家军示好。
战承胤为了制衡齐国，不与楚国联手，给了一批武器。
却只给了武器，没有给子弹。
就是这批货。
被积压在库房里半年之久。
清点了数目，数目上是对的。
没有子弹的枪只能放在仓库吃灰。
战承胤把所有枪械都收入空间，剩下一些老式的冷兵器。
兵器许多都生锈，有了豁口，质量比楚国军队用的还差！
这批武器战承胤没有动，他交代孙将军，蔺校尉，所有守城军，巡逻士兵，禁卫军……热武器全部收缴。
只有掌握了热武器的使用方法，发放了持枪证，才能准许携带热武器。
非必要时，绝不允许对手无寸铁的百姓开枪。
一个上午的时间，战承胤把城中几个武器库全部都清收干净。
至于十三万守城军的去留，战承胤还没有决定！
他们继续守城墙，至于以后分配，去留，和几位副将商议后再决定。
如今守城军士兵被战家军接收第一天，每人发了十斤大米，一包两斤的挂面，五斤蔬菜，一包雪花细盐，一桶两斤花生油。
最让士兵们高兴的，每人还分到两斤腊肉。
他们拿到东西第一时间，就往家里跑，把粮食给家里人。
如今城内不怎么缺水了。
因为每个街道的岔路口，每条巷子，每一个有住户的街区。
不管是世家云集的豪门府邸，还是平民积聚的贫困区。
都有一辆大货车拖着不锈钢大水箱，在发放干净饮用水。
十几位战家军士兵维持秩序。
早上排队打水的人多，中午炎热人少了许多！
早上全家发动能装水的器具，都拿来装水。
中午来的人，几乎不用排队，就能打到水。
content_en:
Ye Mochu specially looked for Zhan Chengyin to see where he was now.
Not in the square in front of the palace, not on the city wall, and not in the patrol army command center.
Finally found it in the weapons warehouse of the defenders.
Captain Lin and General Sun brought him to the warehouse. Tens of thousands of soldiers from the War Army were guarding the warehouse outside.
Accompanying Zhan Chengyin were Xiao Yi and a commander named Chen Hui.
Xiao Yi opened a box of weapons, and there were all guns inside.
This gun still looks a little familiar.
Previously, the state of Qi besieged the state of Chu and showed its favor to the Zhan family army.
In order to check and balance the Qi State, Zhan Chengyin did not join forces with the Chu State and gave him a batch of weapons.
But they were only given weapons, not bullets.
This is the batch.
It has been backlogged in the warehouse for half a year.
I counted the numbers, and they were correct.
A gun without bullets can only sit in a warehouse and collect dust.
Zhan Chengyin put all the firearms into the space, leaving some old-fashioned cold weapons.
Many of the weapons were rusty and had gaps, and their quality was worse than those used by the Chu army!
Zhan Chengyin did not touch this batch of weapons. He told General Sun, Lieutenant Lin, all city defenders, patrol soldiers, imperial guards... to confiscate all hot weapons.
Only those who have mastered the use of thermal weapons and have issued a gun license can be allowed to carry thermal weapons.
It is never allowed to shoot at unarmed civilians unless necessary.
In one morning, Zhan Chengyin cleared out all the weapons depots in the city.
As for the stay of the 130,000 city defenders, Zhan Chengyin has not decided yet!
They continued to guard the city wall. As for the future allocation, whether to stay or go, they would decide after discussing with several lieutenants.
Now, on the first day that the soldiers of the city defenders were taken over by the Zhan Family Army, each of them was given ten kilograms of rice, a two kilogram bag of dried noodles, five kilograms of vegetables, a bag of snowflake fine salt, and a two kilogram bucket of peanut oil.
What pleased the soldiers most was that each man was given two kilograms of bacon.
As soon as they got the things, they ran home and gave the food to their families.
There is no shortage of water in the city now.
Because every street intersection, every alley, and every block with residents.
Whether it is a wealthy mansion where aristocratic families gather, or a poor area where common people gather.
There is a large truck towing large stainless steel water tanks distributing clean drinking water.
More than a dozen Zhan Jiajun soldiers maintained order.
There were many people queuing up to get water in the morning, but there were far fewer people in the hot weather at noon!
In the morning, the whole family started the water-filling utensils and filled them with water.
People who come at noon can get water with almost no need to queue.
title_en: Chapter 1440: Waiting for dinner Chapter 1439: His goal is 30,000 bags a day
